# The Next Web

> Europe's leading tech news platform covering startup funding, AI innovation, and the continental tech ecosystem.

TNW is a comprehensive tech media and events company based in Amsterdam, providing breaking news on European startups, venture capital, and emerging technologies. Beyond news coverage, TNW hosts Europe's largest tech conference and operates coworking spaces for innovators.

## Key Topics

- European tech ecosystem
- Startup funding
- Venture capital
- AI technology
- Deep tech
- Fintech
- Sustainability tech
- Data security
- AI regulation
- Corporate innovation
- Quantum computing
- Biotech
- IPO
- European startups
- Tech policy

## Core Properties

- [TNW Homepage](https://thenextweb.com): TNW homepage: tech news, startup funding, AI launches, and European tech ecosystem
- [TNW Conference 2025](https://thenextweb.com/conference): Europe's leading tech festival in Amsterdam with industry voices and networking (June 19 & 20, 2025)
- [TNW City Coworking](https://thenextweb.com/spaces): TNW City flexible coworking spaces in Amsterdam for startups, scale-ups, and innovators

## Startup & Funding News

- [Latest Tech News](https://thenextweb.com/latest): Latest tech news covering funding, AI products, compliance, and European startups
- [Startups & Technology](https://thenextweb.com/startups-technology): Startup and tech news on AI innovation, funding rounds, and venture capital
- [Investors & Funding](https://thenextweb.com/investors-funding): Venture capital and funding news on IPOs, climate tech, and AI startups

## Technology Verticals

- [Deep Tech News](https://thenextweb.com/deep-tech): Deep tech news on quantum computing, space tech, and healthcare AI innovation
- [Fintech & Ecommerce](https://thenextweb.com/fintech-ecommerce): Fintech and ecommerce news on neobanks, payments, and European startup funding
- [Data & Security](https://thenextweb.com/data-security): Data security and cybersecurity news on privacy, AI regulation, and defense tech
- [Sustainability Tech](https://thenextweb.com/sustainability): Sustainability and cleantech news covering green innovation and circular economy

## European Tech Ecosystem

- [Ecosystems News](https://thenextweb.com/ecosystems): European tech ecosystem news covering startup funding, biotech, and energy storage
- [Government & Policy](https://thenextweb.com/government-policy): Government and policy news on tech regulation, EU policy, and AI governance
- [Corporate Innovation](https://thenextweb.com/corporates-innovation): Corporate innovation news on sustainable business, AI, and emerging tech trends

## Workplace & Events

- [Future of Work](https://thenextweb.com/future-of-work): Future of work news on automation, digital nomads, and workplace trends
- [TNW Conference Coverage](https://thenextweb.com/topic/tnw-conference): TNW Conference news and coverage on tech events, founders, and innovation

## Breaking News

- [Super Micro Chip Smuggling Charges](https://thenextweb.com/news/supermicro-chip-smuggling-export-controls-china): Super Micro indictment on server smuggling, export controls, and chip sanctions
